key_insight: UniBrain is a unified multimodal brain MRI model that can both impute missing imaging modalities and answer understanding/diagnosis tasks in one training framework.
clinical_relevance: It could help clinicians and AI systems work more robustly with incomplete MRI data, which is common in real-world brain imaging workflows.
method: Trains autoregressively on interleaved MRI and text data for joint imputation and understanding.
Uses description-enriched inputs and self-alignment with dense image embeddings to learn fine anatomical detail.
Adds a dynamic hidden-state mechanism to reduce exposure bias during long multimodal inference.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports extensive experiments on a multi-disease brain MRI dataset showing strong performance for imputation, understanding, and diagnosis across different levels of missing modalities.
watch_item: Real-world deployment will depend on whether the model generalizes across scanners, sites, and missing-modality patterns beyond the evaluated dataset.
paper_title: Unified Multimodal Model for Brain MRI Imputation and Understanding
